acquiredModels.registrationAndAccuracyLimits: Source is an artist-authored model, not surveyed CAD. Original local bounds are [-24.822,-180.5,-16.75] to [30,0,10]. Source height 180.5 units requires deliberate scale and bearing registration to published real-world dimensions and mapped tower anchors. Root node includes rotation/translation; apply full hierarchy before alignment. No facades or textures were edited.
